7.3.2.2.3 Contents in the modeled message header file
The modeled message header file contains constexpr variable definition and corre-
sponding type definition for the parameters of the API
ara::log::Logger::Log
,
and those definitions are defined inside user-defined namespaces to avoid variable or
type name collision.
